general_recommendations: Standardize enum values and naming conventions.
Ensure all fields used in the frontend are present in backend models and vice versa.
Use consistent types (e.g., always use 'number' for numeric fields, 'string' for dates/timestamps).
Align nullable/required status for all fields.
Remove unused fields or add them to both sides if needed for business logic.
Maintain a single source of truth for schema (ideally backend), and auto-generate frontend types from backend schema if possible.
